1b1(rgyud): @##//rgya gar skad du/sarba d+harma ma hA san d+hi bo d+ha tsit+ta

1b3(rgyud): sems kun byed rgyal po/bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal 
1b4(rgyud): po la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bshad pa'i dus na/'og min gyi gnas chos 
1b5(rgyud): nyid kyi mkha' dbyings nyid kyi klong sems nyid kyi gnas ye shes sgrib pa mi mnga' 
2a1(rgyud): @##//pa'i gzhal yas khang na nyid kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid kyi ngo bo dang /nyid kyi thugs rje 
2a2(rgyud): ye shes mngon du phyung ba'i 'khor 'di lta ste/nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /
2a3(rgyud): nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longs/spyod 
2a4(rgyud): rdzogs pa'i sku chu zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor longsspyod rdzogs pa'i sku me zhes bya ba'i 'khor 
2a5(rgyud): dang /nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khaur longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ku rlung zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang //nyid kyi ngo bo'i 'khor 
2a6(rgyud): spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nam mkha' zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang gzhan yang thugs rje ye shes mngon du phyung pa'i 
2b1(rgyud): sprul ba'i 'khor 'di lta ste/'dod pa'i khams kyi sems can zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang /gzugs kyi khams kyi sems can zhes ba'i 'khor dang /gzug med pa'i 
2b2(rgyud): khams kyi sems can zhes pa ba'i 'khor dang /gzhan yang nyid kyi rang bzhin la lta ba'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi 'di lta ste/shin tu rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang yongs 
2b3(rgyud): su rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i khor dang /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya ba'i 'khor dang sems dpa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba'i mkhor dang /nyid kyi rang bzhin dang /nyid kyi ngo bo 
2b4(rgyud): dang /nyid kyi thugs rje rang bzhin 'byed pa mi mnga' bas thabs gcig go/gzhan yang nyid kyi rang bzhan rtogs pa'i 'khor 'di lta ste/sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas nyid la 
2b5(rgyud): gnas pa'i 'khor dang /da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis don mdzad pa'i 'khor dang /slad nas 'byon pa'i sangs rgyas nyid las 'byung ba'i 'khor dang /'byed pa mi 
2b6(rgyud): mnga' ba'i rang bzhin gyis thabs gcig par bzhugs so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des 'khor thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir 
2b7(rgyud): 'khor thams cad nyid kyi sems nyid kyi thugs la thim par mdzad do//rang 'byung gi ye shes gsal bar mdzad do//de nas thams cad chos nyid du ldan par bya ba'i phyir thams 
2b8(rgyud): cad bsdus nas thig le chen po gcig tu bzhugs so//de nas sems dpa' de nyid kyi rang bzhin thig le chen po gcig tu gzhugs pa de las byung nas/byang chub kyi sems kun 
3a1(rgyud): @#//byed rgyal po'i spyan sngar dga' ba'i sems kyis dang ba'i mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje la smras pa/sems 
3a2(rgyud): dpa' rdo rje e ma ho//dga' ba'i sems skyes e ma ho//dang ba'i mdangs phyung e ma ho//nga las byung ba e ma ho//zhes gsungs pas/de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus 
3a3(rgyud): pa|kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//ston pa nyid kyang thig le spros med dam//'khor rnams kun kyang thig le spros med dam //bstan pa kun kyang thig le 
3a4(rgyud): spros med dam//dus dang gnas kyang thig le spros med dam//thams cad kun kyang thig le'i rang bzhin na//ston pa'i ston pas ci zhig ston par mdzad//'khor du 'khor ba'i 
3a5(rgyud): don ni ci la 'khor//'khor la bstan pa ci zhig ston par byed//dus dang gnas ni gcig pa ji lta bu//zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byad rgyal po des 
3a6(rgyud): sems dpa' rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po yid sgra la chug cig/ngas don sgrar bshad kyis/kye sems dpa' chen po/sems nyid kun byed rgyal 
3a7(rgyud): po nga nyid ni//chos rnams thams cad kun gyi snying po ste//snying po ma spros ye nas thig le yin//thig le ye nas spros pa med pa'i don//ston pa dang ni bstan pa 'khor dus 
3a8(rgyud): gnas//nga las byung bas ye nas thig le ste//nga yi rang bzhin thig le bstan pa yin//zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste

4a1(rgyud): @#//rigs dang /rang 'byung ye shes 'dod chags kyi rigs dang /rang 'byung yeshes gti mug gi rigs dang /rang 'byung yi shes phrag dog gi rigs dang /
4a2(rgyud): rang 'byung ye shes nga rgyal gyi rigs dang /rang 'byung nge shes lnga'i rigs lus rgyan gyi lus can gyi chos nyid bkod do//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po de nyid kyang 
4a3(rgyud): nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi chos nyid bkod pa de bzhin du bzhugs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rje de byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po'i spyan sngar yang 'dug nas/kye ston pa 
4a4(rgyud): kun byed rgyal po lags//nyid kyi thugs gcig rang 'byung ye shes las//rang 'byung ye shes rnam pa lnga byung nas//de las rgyan gyi rgyu lnga byung nas ni//ye shes lnga 
4a5(rgyud): yi lus lnga blangs pa 'dis//kun byed rgyal po'i dgos pa ci zhig che//zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun gyi byed rgyal po des slar gsungs pa/kye sems dpa' 
4a6(rgyud): chen po dgos pa ni//kun byed rgyal po byed mkhan nga las ni//ma gtogs pa yi byed mkhan gzhan na med//chos nyid byed pa yang ni nga las med//ston pa gsum yang 'god pa 
4a7(rgyud): nga las med//'khor gyi tshogs kyang 'god pa nga las med//de bzhin chos nyid 'god pa nga las med/sems dpa' rdo rje khyod la nga yis ni//nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya//
4a8(rgyud): nga la rang bzhin rnam pa gsum yod de//nga yi rang bzhin byang chub sems yin no//byang ba dag gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni//phun sum tshogs pa rnam gsum chos nyid byang //chub 
4b1(rgyud): pa dag gi rang bzhin bstan pa ni//dgos pa tshogs pa rnam pa gsum gyis ni//nam mkha' bzhin du kun la khyab par gnas//sems shes bya ba'i rang bzhin bstan pa ni/
4b2(rgyud): mi 'gag ma lus kun byed rgyal po ste//kun byas byang chub sems su ma lus byas//shes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos nyid mngon du phyung nas 
4b3(rgyud): bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed/rgyal po des chos thams cad kyi sngon rol du byed pa po nga byung ba 'di gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen 
4b4(rgyud): po yid rna dbang la zhugs shig/rna dbang sgra la rtogs shig/kye nga ni kun byed rgyal po ste//nga ni kun byed byang chub sems//nga med pa yi sngon rol na//chos rnams 'byung ba'i 
4b5(rgyud): snying po med//nga med pa yi sngon rolan//chos kun byed pa'i rgyal po med//nga med pa yi sngaun rol na//ston pa bya ba ye nas med//nga med pa yi sngo rol na//bstan pa bya ba 
4b6(rgyud): ye nas med//nga med pa'i sngon rol na//'khor zhes bya ba ye nas med//sems dpa' rdo rje rtog ma skye//sems dpa' chen po khyod nyid kyang //nga yi ngo bo sprul pa yin//
4b7(rgyud): zhes gsungs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes byang chub kyi sems kun gyi rgyal po la zhus pa/kye kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems//khyod ni ye nas chen po yin//
4b8(rgyud): ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor la sogs pa'i chos rnams kun//byed mkhan khyod kyis byas pas na//ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun//byed khan khyod kyis 
5a1(rgyud): @#//byas par snang //ston pa gcig gam rnam pa du ru yod//bstan pa gcig gam rnam pa ru ru yod//'khor rnams gcig gam rnam pa du ru yid//
5a2(rgyud): ces zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos slar gsungs pa/kye rang 'byung ye shes kun gyi ston par gcig/nga yi rang bzhin rnam gsum snang ba la//
5a3(rgyud): ston pa'i grangs ni rnam pa gsum du byung //nga ni de bzhin nyid du gcig pa las//chos rnams kun gyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid//nga nyid byang chub sems las gzhan med do//
5a4(rgyud): nga las byung ba'i ston pa sku gsum gyis//'khor la bstan pa rnam pa gsum du bstan//nga yi ngo bo gcig tu phyung nas ni//nga yi rang bzhin gcig tu bstan pa'i phyir//
5a5(rgyud): kun byed nga yi 'khor du kun kyang gcig/nga las byung ba'i ston pa klu gsum gyis//'khor gyi bye brag rnam pa gsum du yod//ces gsungs so//sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/
5a6(rgyud): kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//khyod las byung ba'i ston pa sku bsum la//khyod sar 'gro ba'i lam ni yod dam med//med na khyod kyi sa ru phyin mi phyin//yod na 
5a7(rgyud): bgrod nas phyin nam ma bgrod phyin//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig/nga las byung ba'i stonapa sku gsum la//nga yis ru bgrod pa'i lam med de//nga yi rang byung ye shes 
5a8(rgyud): bstan pa yin//sku gsum ston pa de yi 'khor rnams la//rnam par thar pa'i lam ni rnam lnga ste//dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi lam du bstan//rang 'byung ye shes lnga yi 
5b1(rgyud): lam lnga ni//'dod chags dang ni zhe sdang gti mug dang //nga rgyal dang ni phrag dog rnam lnga ste//rang 'byung ye shes rnam lnga kun gyi lam//zhes gsungs so//ston pa'i ston pa kun byed 
5b2(rgyud): rgyal po lags//rang 'byung ye shes lam lnga bstan pa de//rang 'byung zhes ni ji ltar byung ba lags//ye shes bya ba'i gtan tshigs ci la gdags//lam zhes bgyi ba'i don ni gang la 
5b3(rgyud): bgyi//'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang //phrag dog la sogs rnam pa lnga po de//lam lnga yin pa'i don ni bshad du gsol//zhes zhus so//kye sems dpa' chen po/rang 'byung 
5b4(rgyud): ye shes rnam pa lam lnga ni//rang 'byung rgyu rkyen med par byung ba yin//ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal ba yin//lam ni rgyu rkyen med pas bgrod mi dgos//mi bgrod rang 'byung lnga la 
5b5(rgyud): lam lngar bshad//'dod pa chos rnams bdag tu 'dod pa yin//chags pa bdag tu 'dod pa de la chags//zhe sdang skye ba med pa'i rang bzhin la//sdang ba cho 'phrul sna tshogs de la sdang//
5b6(rgyud): gti mug mi rtog pa yi ting 'dzin gyis//chos nyid mnyam pa nyid la dbye gsal med//nga ni ma nor ba yi byang chub sems//de bzhin nyid du ye nas rgyal bar byed//thams cad de bzhin nyid 
5b7(rgyud): du gcig pa la//yin min sgro skur 'debs la phrag dog byed//bgrod du med pa'i lam lnga bstan pa yin//kye sems dpa' chen bo nyon cig/ji ltar snang ba'i chos rnams thams cad kun//
5b8(rgyud): rang 'byung ye shes lam lnga 'di las byung //'dod pa'i khams kyang rang 'byung ye shes yin//gzugs kyi khams kyang rang 'byung ye shas yin//gzugs med khams kyang rang 'byung ye shis 
6a1(rgyud): @#//yin//kun byed rgyal po nga yis byas pa'i phyir//ngas byas thams cad ye shes ngo bor bshad//khams gsum sems can rgyud drug thams cad kun//
6a2(rgyud): rang 'byung ye shes min par ngas ma bshad//de las ma gtogs pa yi byang chub sems//sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po ngas ma bshad//kun byed rgyal po nga yi rang bzhin la//chos 
6a3(rgyud): nyid rnam pa gsum du bstan pa ste//ma skyes pa yi chos nyid dngos mi snang //de ni gzugs med khams su bstan pa yin//skye ba'i cho 'phrul gzugs su snang ba ni//de ni gzugs 
6a4(rgyud): kyi khams su bstan pa yin/thugs rje ye shes ngo bo mngon phyung nas//bde sdug las de thugs rjes zad bya'i phyir//'dod pa'i khams ni thugs rjes phyung ba yin//zhes gsungs so//
6a5(rgyud): byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po las chos thams cad kun byed rgyal pos byas pa las ji ltar byung ba'i khungs bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems 
6a6(rgyud): kun byed rgyal po des nyid kyi rang bzhin mtshan gyi chos bshad pa 'di gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po rdo rje khyod nyon cig/nga ni ye nas rang 'byung ye shes te//nga ni ye nas chos kun 
6a7(rgyud): snying po yin//nga ni kun byed rgyal po byang chub sems//nga yi mtshan 'di sems dpa' rtogs par gyis//nga yi mtshan 'di sem dpas rtogs 'gyur na//chos rnams thams cad ma lus rtogs 
6a8(rgyud): 'gyur gyis//nga zhes bya ba'i snying po ste//chos rnams kun gyi snying po yin//rang 'byung zhes ni bya ba ni//rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po bas//rtsol sgrub kun las 'das pa yin//ye shes 
6b1(rgyud): zhes ni bya ba ni//'gag pa med cing ma bsgribs pas//chos kun ma lus ston par byed//nga ni byang chub sems la bya//ye nas bya ba'i don 'di ni//thog ma nyid nas gnas 
6b2(rgyud): pa'i don//chos kun zhes ni bya ba ni//ston pa kun kyang chos nyid la//bstan pa kun kyang chos nyid yin//'khor gnas dus kyang chos nyid de//chos nyid ma yin gcig kyang 
6b3(rgyud): med//snying po bya ba'i don 'di ni//thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po ste//byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las//ston pa gsum yang de las byung //bstan pa gsum yang de las byu ba//
6b4(rgyud): 'khor gnas dus kyang de las byung //thams cad 'byung ba'i snang por bshad//nga ni snying po sems nyid kyis//chos rnams ma lus kun byed de//kun zhes bya ba'i chos rnams 
6b5(rgyud): kun//chos kun gang dang gang zhe na//ston pa dang ni bstan pa dang //'khor gnas dus ni thams cad kun//byed ces bya ba mkhan po ste//ston pa dang ni bstan dang //'khor 
6b6(rgyud): gnas dus ni kun byed pas//rang 'byung ye shes mkhan po yin//rgyal po zhes ni bya ba ni//snying po rang 'byung ye shes de//byed pa'i mkhan po kun las rgyal//chos rnams byed 
6b7(rgyud): mkhan kun las rgyal//byang ba'i don ni 'di lta ste//snying po byang chub sems de ni//rang 'byung ye nas rnam dag pas//kun byed rgyal pos byas pa kun//kun bzang nyid du rnam dag 
6b8(rgyud): pas//byang zhes bya bar bshad pa yin//chub ces bya ba 'di lta ste//snying po rang 'byung ye shas des//snang ba dang ni srid pa dang //snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa dang //dus gsum 
7a1(rgyud): sangs rgyas thams cad dang //khams gsum rgyud drug sems can dang //de bzhin nyid ni thams cad la//kun la chu ba ste khyab par gnas//des na chu ba 
7a2(rgyud): ces bya bar bshad//sems kyi don ni 'di lta ste//snying po rang 'byung ye shes des//snang srid snod bcud thams cad la//'jug cing dbang sgyur gsal bar gcod//des na 
7a3(rgyud): sems zhes bya bar bshad//rgyu rkyen med pa'i snying po des//kun la dbang sgyur thams cad byed//kye sems dpa' chen po/nga yi rang bzhin rtogs gyur na//ston pa kun kyang rtogs 
7a4(rgyud): 'gyur la//bstan pa kun kyang rtogs par 'gyur//'khor gyi bsam pa rig 'gyur la//dus gnas kun kyang gcig 'gyur rig/chos rnams thams cad nga yin pas//nga yi 
7a5(rgyud): rang bzhin 'di rig na//chos rnams thams cad rig 'gyur bas//bya byed rtsol sgrub kun las 'das//mi rtsol lhun gyis grub par 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems 
7a6(rgyud): kun byed rgyal po las nga nyid kyi mtshan bshad pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal pos sems dpa' rdo rje la nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i mdo 'dus 
7a7(rgyud): pa'i don 'di bstan to//kye sems dpa' chen pa nyon cig/nga yi rang bzhin 'di lta ste/yod ni gcig las med pa ste//bstan ni rnam pa gnyis su bstan//byung na theg pa dgu ru byung //
7a8(rgyud): 'dus ni rdzogs pa chen por 'dus//yin ni byang chub sems yin te//gnas ni chos nyid dbyings la gnas//gsal ni rig pa mkha' la gsal//khyab ni snod bcud kun la khyab//
7b1(rgyud): byung ni snang srid kun du byung //bstan du mtshan ma'i dngos po med//mthong du dmigs pa'i yul dang bral//shes su tshig tu brjod du med//rgyu las ma byung snying po 'di//sgros kyi btags 
7b2(rgyud): pa kun dang bral//don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na//dpe ni nam mkha' lta bur brtag/don ni chos nyid skye ba med//rtags ni sems nyid 'gag pa med//nam mkha' lta bu'i chos nyid la//
7b3(rgyud): nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe yis mtshon//dmigs su med pa'i chos nyid la//dmigs su med par mtshon te bstan//tshig tu brjod du med pa la//brjod du med pa'i tshig brjod de//
7b4(rgyud): dmigs med don gyi ngo bor bstan//bsdus te bstan pa'i don 'di ni//don gyi ngo bo 'grel ba ste//'di yis nga don rtogs par gyis//'di yis nga don rtog par byed//'di yis nga don ma 
7b5(rgyud): rtogs na//don gyi sgra tshig ci bstan kyang //nga dang phrad par mi 'gyur te//nga las gol la nga bsgribs pas//chos kyi snying po mthong mi 'gyur//zhes gsungs so//byang chub kyi sems kun 
7b6(rgyud): byed rgyal po las don gyi 'grel pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o////de nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po des chos thams cad nyid kyi rang bzhin la rdzogs pa chen po de bstan pa'i tshig gsungs so//
7b7(rgyud): kye sems dpa' rdo rje tshig 'di nyon//kun byed rgyal po nga yis ni//nga yi chos rnams dang por bkod//nga yi chos rnams mngon du phyung //nga yi ngo bo khyod la bstan//nga yi rang bzhin bstan nas 
7b8(rgyud): ni//tshig dang sgras kyang don mtshon nas//ngo bo bstan pas khyod kyis mthong //rang bzhin bstan pas a de rig/tshig tu brjod pas don sgrar thos//shes gsungs nas cang mi gsung bar 
8a1(rgyud): @#//chos thams cad kyi ngo bor bzhugs so//sems dpa' rdo rje 'khor gyi nang nas langs nas byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po'i zhal du mdangs phyung ste 'khod pas 
8a2(rgyud): kun byed rgyal pos/kye sems dpa' chen po khyod nga la mdangs kyis 'khod pa de khyod kyis don ci 'dod pa gsol cig/ces gsungs so//de nas sems dpa' rdo rjes zhus pa/
8a3(rgyud): kye ston pa'i ston pa kun byed rgyal po lags//chos rnams thams cad khyod kyi rang bzhin na//khyod kyis ston pa bstan pa 'khor bkod ci zhig lags//phun sum tshogs pa'i 
8a4(rgyud): dgos pa ci zhig lags//zhes zhus so//de nas byang chub kyi sems ku na byed rgyal pos 'di skad ces gsungs so//kye sems dpa' chen po nyon cig/chos rnams phun sum 
8a5(rgyud): tshogs par bkod pa ni//nga nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin te//nga yi rang bzhin khyod la bstan par bya//nga yi rang bzhin spros bral mi phyed pas//chos dbyings gnas 'di nga yis 
8a6(rgyud): byas pa yin//byang chub nyid las de na gzhan mi bzhugs//nga yi rang bzhin ma bsgribs kun khyab pas//gsal ba'i nam mkha' ye shes gzhal yas khang //rang 'byung ye shes 
8a7(rgyud): nyid las gzhan mi bzhugs//nga ni thams cad 'byung ba'i snying po bas//chen po lnga dang khams gsum rgyud drug rnams//nga yi sku gsung thugs las gzhan med pas//nga yi 
8a8(rgyud): rang bzhin nga yis bkod pa yin//dus gsum sangs rgyas khams gsum sems can yang //nga yi rang bzhin khyed la bstan pa yin//nga yi rang bzhin ma skyes spros bral phyir//
8b1(rgyud): mi gnas spyod yul kun las 'das pa yin//mi snang ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i yul las 'das//nga yi rang bzhin khyed la mi snang yang //nga yi ngo bo khyod la snang byas pas//khams 
8b2(rgyud): gsum chen po lnga dang rgyud drug rnams//snang ba'i rang bzhin byang chub sems lnga las//rang 'byung snying po ye shes lnga byung bas//ye shes lnga yi yul lnga gsal byung bas//'dod 
8b3(rgyud): pa lnga byung chags pa lnga byung nas//chags lnga so sor smin pa'i 'bras bu ni//'gro ba drug gi khyad par so sor snang //'di ltar snang ba nga yis khyed la bstan pa yin//sku gsum theg pa rnam 
8b4(rgyud): pa drug bstan pa//nga yis bstan na khyed kyis ma mthong ste//de re nga yi rang bzhin re re la//de re nga yi ngo bo re re ste//sku re dang ni gsung re thugs re dang //kun gyis mthong ba'i ngo bo re re'o//
